defined_text = {
	name = mdr_space_next_step
	text = {
		trigger = { check_variable = { mdr_space_sites < 1 } }
		localization_key = MDR_SPACE_STEP_SITE
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { check_variable = { mdr_space_budget < 1 } }
		localization_key = MDR_SPACE_STEP_BUDGET
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { OR = { AND = { mdr_sg_orbit_met = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_sg_orbit_claimed } } AND = { mdr_sg_crew_met = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_sg_crew_claimed } } AND = { mdr_sg_station_met = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_sg_station_claimed } } AND = { mdr_sg_moon_return_met = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_sg_moon_return_claimed } } AND = { mdr_sg_moon_colony_met = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_sg_moon_colony_claimed } } AND = { mdr_sg_mars_robot_met = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_sg_mars_robot_claimed } } AND = { mdr_sg_mars_crew_met = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_sg_mars_crew_claimed } } AND = { mdr_sg_mars_colony_met = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_sg_mars_colony_claimed } } } }
		localization_key = MDR_SPACE_STEP_GOAL
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { check_variable = { mdr_space_active < 1 } }
		localization_key = MDR_SPACE_STEP_IDLE
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { check_variable = { var = mdr_space_active compare = less_than value = mdr_space_slots } }
		localization_key = MDR_SPACE_STEP_ROOM
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = MDR_SPACE_STEP_WAIT
	}
}
